intro: Lesson 14: Hudaybiyyah: patience and the wisdom behind the terms. Plan or write in each box.

parts.text: 1) The term: Makkans who joined the Muslims were returned. 2) Abu Basir was returned but escaped and set up camp. 3) Others joined; they attacked caravans. 4) Quraysh asked the Prophet ﷺ to take them, ending the term.
